## 维护者速读
- Studio 校验规则面板里,状态机的每一行流转多了「可清空」勾选框;管理员能在 Studio 里允许某状态下清空该字段,编辑这一行也不会再悄悄丢掉已有的「可清空」。
- 属于「Studio 编辑元数据不破坏原有规则」这条线,修掉一个编辑后用户清空字段被拒的问题。
- 出错的话只影响这个面板的显示与写回;服务端校验不变,可直接撤回。
- 无需你操作。

## 席位核对

Verdict: **ACCEPT** at head `26b38360d0c6bd08c2ccc5a30c4281d6907344c2` (read 2026-11-23T14:37Z).

1. **Shape.** Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36567`; both "done when" items are delivered (an explicit "May be cleared" control, an edit keeps an existing `''`, and the `paused: ['open', '']` round-trip pin with one ablation), so `Fixes` is right. No closing keyword binds another card. `mergeable_state: clean`.
2. **Premise measured.** `origin/main`: `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx:597` parses the targets with `.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)`, the only such parse in the file, and the box displayed `to.join(', ')`. On the head the box shows and parses named targets only and carries `to.includes('')` through `rowTargets`; the checkbox adds or removes `''`; both write through the same `setRow`, so the blank-row hold (#26731) applies to the checkbox too.
3. **Gates at this head (check-runs).** 45 success · 13 expected skip · 0 unexpected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check both `success` (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36719`, clean on all 13 items).
4. **Accepted deviations.** Tests: red on base (both cases fail with the panel and catalogues restored to 9348f02b) and an ablation of the carried `to.includes('')` turning the round-trip case red, restored to the head blob; every written rule is checked with a full `ValidationRuleSchema.safeParse`. Nit, accepted as is: `''` is always written last, so a hand-written `['', 'open']` comes back as `['open', '']` after a row edit — the same set, and the targets are read as a set. Strings: the studio namespace has exactly two catalogues (`en.ts`, `zh.ts`), both given the two new keys. Changeset read sentence by sentence against the diff: every sentence true; `@object-ui/i18n` (published) carries its `patch` entry beside the private `@object-ui/app-shell`.
5. **Out of scope.** None found. `Skills-docs:` not owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`, no narrowing arm).
6. **Landing.** No contract face: no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed path, no `Clause-②: yes`, no narrowing, so no L2 is owed; this record is the review of record at `TIER_DEFAULT`. No `content/docs/releases/` path. SQL push-down: not applicable. Land on this head, or on a main-sync head after a delta read.
